title: Mediterranean blocks Brown completion cheaply
description: Mediterranean blocks Brown completion cheaply. The low price and blocking value outweigh the weak rent profile. A shallow policy would choose start_auction; the decisive detail is the current mix of liquidity, opponent cash, and set leverage.

final_action.private_thought: Buying Mediterranean gives me the brown monopoly (both properties). With cash 620, paying 60 leaves 560, ample for future houses. No reason to auction; securing monopoly early is key.
